title: TempTarget-triggered loop run does not see TT itself
body:
check the log
17:37:05.116 NSClient event for TT hypo set to 6.5: `"created_at":"2022-12-27T14:13:41.000Z","timestamp":1672150421000`
17:37:05.125 NSClient event for new TT of 6.0 received `"created_at":"2022-12-27T14:36:27.000Z","timestamp":1672151787000`
17:37:05.128 [ENPlugin.invoke():109]: invoke from EventTempTargetChange
17:37:05.139 D/DATABASE: [NSClientAddUpdateWorker.doWork():186]: Inserted TemporaryTarget  record
17:37:10.183 loop started but it has `"temptargetSet":false`

old TT was not canceled, only new one started.  but loop run got `false` for temptargetSet in profile data. so all the safety of disabled 'allow smb on high tt' failed.
potentially pretty dangerous behaviour.

[AndroidAPS_TT.log](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/10309233/AndroidAPS_TT.log)
